verdictSummary: One MEDIUM contract/model gap on the sealed policy payload side (P02-M1) plus five LOW. The envelope side is sound in every reviewer probe: authority originates outside the registry, closed bounded canonical envelope codec, fixed domain projection, stable RegistryRecordIdentity, fresh same-record repeat vs replay/equivocation, generation/capsule/floor substitution, full-interval time predicates, CI required/optional sets, V0/V1, closed 14 private reasons and constant opaque public refusal. No HIGH. Not ACCEPT_FOR_BOUNDED_DESIGN because the contract claims precise verification semantics before a factory and the normative authority matrix leaves the payload origin/join/projection undefined.
accepted: Authority graph starts at an independently provisioned capsule/bootstrap decision; registry, provider, plan and payload cannot choose anchor, expected selector/scope/version, verifier, verdict or CI policy; real custody/bootstrap/capsule/anchors NULL/HOLD and not simulated (real-bindings-HOLD.json).
Existing normalized-proof-v1, node-leaf/planning/TLS and the 28 descriptor purposes are explicitly NOT registry authorization; candidate format/purpose/domain stay UNREGISTERED.

Envelope codec: strict UTF-8, no BOM/duplicate/trailing/float/NaN/-0/escape alias, ints 0..2^53-1 excluding bool, size/depth/node/string budgets, canonical round-trip, fixed run/job/step order (R13-R21 all refuse as specified).
Signature message = domain || NUL || canonical {body,signer}; SPKI fingerprint over DER from the capsule; whole raw response digest separate from projection digest.

RegistryRecordIdentity: exhaustive single-field mutation (R04) shows exactly issuedAt, requestBindingSHA256, validUntil and facts.runningMeasurementSHA256 are excluded, matching contract.md:148-156; every other safety-relevant body/facts/ciRuns field is bound.

Fresh same-record repeat with new ticket, issuedAt, validUntil and running proof is legal (R02/R03); signed fork with same recordVersion refuses VERSION (R05); generation/capsule substitution SCOPE (R06/R07); floor ahead VERSION (R08); old response into new ticket REPLAY (owner N10).
Original source anchors precede the record; current head/status/running acquired independently; first publication ABSENT stays HOLD; H1-H7 remain named dependencies with actual NULL.

CI: authenticated run for another head, run failure with green steps, required neutral, required/optional overlap all refuse CI (R09-R12), exercising model lines 236-247 that owner N42-N47 never reach (they stop at a.ci byte equality).
Closed 14 private reasons equal refusal-matrix ids; production_projection is constant TRUST_UNKNOWN_OR_PIN_MISMATCH for every probe (R34).

Owner evidence honesty: 100 cases / 4 SYNTHETIC_ALREADY_BOUND / 96 refusals / 0 failures, signature table explicitly already-bound, no Ed25519/X509/OS/provider/clock authentication; N46 fixture-order failure and generator SyntaxError preserved; two superseded passing reports labelled non-final. findings.title: Sealed policy payload is opaque: no codec in the model, no payload-envelope joins, no digest derivations, no policyData projection
findings.source: contract.md:187-199 and 203-211 (payload codec, 'exact payload/hash/graph/contracts/grants/member bindings', authority matrix normative, 'missing or ambiguous origin fails'); candidate_model.py:249 (payload only hashed); authority-matrix.json rows cover only envelope fields; policy.go:43-62 policyData/provenance
counterexamples: R25 leading-space noncanonical payload, R26 non-JSON bytes, R27 payload self-asserting status and RegistrySHA256: each with independently bound policyPayloadSHA256 returns SYNTHETIC_ALREADY_BOUND although contract.md:187-191 requires exact canonical bytes and the closed schema with no status/RegistrySHA256.

R28 schema-valid payload with selector 'another_selector', verifier.sourceSHA/artifactSHA256 different from facts and ciRunIDs [777] not in ciRuns returns SYNTHETIC_ALREADY_BOUND; contract step 5 requires exact payload joins.

R29 facts.graphSHA256 differs from SHA256(payload.graphHex) and the bound control still passes: no derivation is defined for graphSHA256, contractSetSHA256, semanticPinsSHA256 (the payload has no semantic-pins member at all), cohortScopeSHA256, keyGrantsSHA256, registryProofSlotsSHA256, designRegistrationSHA256.

R30 contract.md defines only policyData.RegistrySHA256 (line 193). K1 policyData.Provenance has 15 fields with a single CIRunID/CIJobID/ArtifactDigest and ApprovedReviewScope; with up to 8 ciRuns, integer ciRunIDs vs K1 []string, integer grant times vs time.Time, authorityScopeC2Hex decoding and grant Status from independent status, the step-7 checkPolicyBindings input is not determined. If a future factory filled both ReviewScope and ApprovedReviewScope from facts.reviewScope, the K1 scope check would be vacuous.

findings.minimalCorrection: Add a normative payload table: (a) strict canonical codec identical to the envelope rules plus hex round-trip and the closed payload schema, modelled in evaluate before any join; (b) exact joins payload.selector==body.selector, payload.verifier.sourceSHA==facts.sourceSHA, artifactSHA256==facts.binarySHA256, reviewSHA==facts.reviewSHA, ciRunIDs==ordered ciRuns[*].runId, version mapping to recordVersion or an explicit independent version fact; (c) a defined derivation (exact canonical bytes) for every payload-derived facts digest, or delete facts that have none; (d) a policyData projection table field-by-field with origin, including which run/job populates CIRunID/CIJobID, ArtifactDigest==artifactZipSHA256, RunningExecutableSHA256 origin, and ApprovedReviewScope from the capsule/Root coverage mapping, never from facts.reviewScope; (e) model cases for each with benign controls.

findings.title: Owner schema harness accepts trailing LF in pattern fields
findings.source: candidate-envelope.schema.json patterns ^...$ evaluated by Python jsonschema 4.26.0 (re.search, $ matches before a final newline); contract.md:178-179 'schema and pure model pin the same field set and limits'

findings.title: Consumer-side fresh running proof digest is signed by the read-snapshot issuer
findings.source: contract.md:153-156, BODY facts.runningMeasurementSHA256; authority-matrix row says independent producer, never record self-measurement
findings.counterexample: None unsafe: the value must equal the independent running snapshot (R03). But the registry signer must learn the consumer's fresh measurement for every read, which couples H5 to the registry issuer and reads like registry attestation of running code.
findings.minimalCorrection: Remove it from the signed body (keep approved target identities), or state that it is an echo bound through requestBindingSHA256 with zero authentication weight and that only the H5 measurement authenticates.
